reviews.review: The amount of glitches that we came across in this game were ridiculous. The final fight we replayed 4 times because glitches stopped the game from advancing. Two times the same glitch happened in that final fight. We pushed through the entire game, cause though it was no where near the level of game we expect we had fun playing together (fiancee and I). If I could get my money back I would most assuredly request it. The potential was there but the execution was flat at best.

If you haven't played this game before, you need to.  By the design and how everything is put out in the game, you will appreciate every aspect.  Every aspect of every other game because this game is so boring it'll make checkers feel like a first person shooter.

As a Person who has been waiting for this game since the beginning of it's development, I was Greatly amazed by the game on release, I had ignored everyone's petty complaints and everyone's terrible remarks, kept the game, played it with my friend and we had a BLAST, so to the people who say this game sucked, you clearly can't find enjoyment in something even if it's buggy, I love this game, The story is amazing (could be more involving), Moral is, Games are buggy in this time of age, deal with it, suck it up, have fun with your friends.
